'''Saiy Engineering Workshop''' was run by the [[Saiy]] family on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. The son of the owner, [[Barit Saiy]] befriended [[Ben Skywalker]] during the internment of [[Corellian/Legends|Corellians]] on Coruscant.
